answer: At unpredictable moments each epoch, summon random pairs to a brief live exchange: each must answer, within minutes, a question drawn from the other's earlier work, while dozens of such sessions run at once across the meadow. One operator running a sparrow flock of clones cannot be present in many distinct conversations at once — answering one well means abandoning another. The form is sonnet-fixed, fourteen lines of exchange, but the questions are fresh every time, so presence itself becomes the scarce resource clones cannot fake.
